name: ather
description: Ather studio mods for Claude Code (S2 Director Kit).

plugins.name: ather-automata
plugins.description: What needs you, what to do next, and a safe pair of hands while you are away: the S2 way of working with Claude Code.

plugins.name: ather-board
plugins.description: The team's intents as a project board: what is stuck, what collides, every intent by owner, area or stage, the open acceptance items, and a page to share. Read-only.

plugins.name: ather-lanes
plugins.description: The machine's S2 agent lanes as a board: the decisions waiting for you, the lanes that need a look, and every lane with its slot, branch and PR; a status line with this session's lane and what waits, and tools Claude calls to answer which lane it is in and to open the board. Read-only; starts no process while the pane is closed.

plugins.name: week-calendar
plugins.description: Weekly calendar and agent-effectiveness report for agent PCs: PRs merged and productive agent time, published to the team's agent-reports repo.
